blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At a briefing on Tuesday, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said those criticizing President Marcos’ advice for the public to buy buckets and collect water ahead of Super El Niño should instead buy themselves “buckets and buckets of brains” to appreciate the President’s plan. Anticipating the negative impacts of Super El Niño, Marcos, in a media interview in Singapore on Oct. 11, advised his countrymen to collect rainwater: “Bumili na kayo ng balde para ’pag umulan, makolekta na ninyo lahat,” a suggestion that drew mixed reactions.
